name: Stepper
description:
Progress through a multi-step task: numbered markers joined by a line, a check on finished
steps and a mark on steps that need attention. It shows progress; the content and the
Back and Next buttons belong to the page or a Wizard.
signature: ({ steps, value, onValueChange, navigation, orientation, children, locale, labels, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: StepperProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: Content under the current step in the vertical layout (a step-by-step form on one page).

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ steps: string; stepOf: (step: number, total: number) => string; complete: string; current: string; error: string; optional: string; skipped: string; back: string; next: string; finish: string; finishing: string; finished: string; skip: string; }> | undefined

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: navigation
props.description: Which steps can be chosen (StepperNavigation). Default none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with a step's id when the person chooses it (see `navigation`).

props.name: orientation
props.description:
`horizontal` (default) lays the steps along a line, and below a container width shows
"Step 2 of 5" with the current step's name and a progress bar instead; `vertical` stacks
them, for a side rail or a step-by-step page.
